subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Does the final operator-visible degradation payload—owner identity, path, sanitized reason, cold/stale state, and reload hint—meet the intended secret-redaction boundary for logs and doctor output?
rationale: This is a protected security-sensitive diagnostics contract; code review can identify leakage or misleading diagnostics, but maintainers must choose the acceptable operator-detail boundary.

options.title: Approve the bounded diagnostics contract
options.body: Accept the redacted owner and reason fields after the current-head proof confirms no SecretRef identifiers or values are exposed.

options.title: Reduce exposed operator detail
options.body: Require a narrower public diagnostic shape if owner IDs or config paths are considered too sensitive for the existing log and doctor surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded diagnostics contract
recommendation.body: Accept the redacted owner and reason fields after the current-head proof confirms no SecretRef identifiers or values are exposed.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the merged secret-owner isolation and degraded-state contract that this PR extends.
